case: An ordinary configuration -- one that declares no control object kind -- admitted normally, which must not be refused.
why: The chapter states this case in as many words. `control_object_kind` stays OPTIONAL on `ConfigurationVersion`: the ordinary admission path requires no protected change, and declaring the kind is what makes one mandatory through `dependentRequired`. The patch adds a fourth ordinary configuration kind to the record's own `kind` vocabulary and leaves the control-object conditional untouched, so an admission with no control object declared must still pass. A control that refused it would have made every configuration change a C5 change, which is the opposite error and just as expensive.
